{{Quote|Should the rakghoul problem grow out of hand, the Imperial First Fleet is preauthorized to commence full-scale orbital bombardment of Alderaan.|The Imperial News Network|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Imperial First Fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], when the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] broke out on several worlds, the Imperial First Fleet was stationed above those worlds in order to execute a full-scale orbital bombardment if the outbreak grew out of control.<ref name="TOR" />
